metadata.geometry_source: Experimental equilibrium bond length r_e(LiH) = 1.5949 Angstrom (Huber & Herzberg, via NIST CCCBDB), rounded to 1.595. Identical to the geometry in ../lih/chemistry.py, which is what makes the QARP/Qulacs and Qiskit Aer results comparable.
metadata.model_note: Vacuum full STO-3G space in canonical RHF orbitals. With every orbital active, CASCI is FCI, so the reference is the exact STO-3G energy. STO-3G itself is roughly 1 kcal/mol from the basis-set-limit LiH energy, so 'chemical accuracy' here means against FCI in this basis, not against experiment.
metadata.reference_solver: exact diagonalization in the N-electron sector
